name: Capivasertib + Fulvestrant (CAPItello-291)
cyclesNote: Cycled every 28 days continuously until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. Capivasertib given intermittently (4 days on, 3 days off weekly).

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026
source.primaryStudy: CAPItello-291: Turner NC, Oliveira M, Howell SJ, et al. N Engl J Med 2023;388:2058-2070

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (NCCN v6.2026 BINV-Q 6, 14 of 15)

biomarkers.note: Requires HR-positive, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer with one or more PIK3CA, AKT1, or PTEN alterations detected by an FDA-approved or validated NGS/PCR test, following progression on or recurrence after at least one line of endocrine therapy (± CDK4/6 inhibitor). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026, BINV-Q (6 of 15 and 14 of 15) (Category 1, Preferred).

supportiveCare: Hyperglycemia monitoring and management: Assess fasting plasma glucose (FPG) and HbA1c before starting. Educate patient on symptoms of hyperglycemia (polydipsia, polyuria). Initiate metformin or other antidiabetic agents if FPG > 160 mg/dL.
Diarrhea management: Start loperamide at first onset of loose stools. Ensure oral rehydration.
Cutaneous rash: Monitor for maculopapular rash or severe cutaneous reactions; topical corticosteroids and oral antihistamines may be used for mild-to-moderate rash.
monitoring: Fasting plasma glucose (FPG) at baseline, every 2 weeks for the first month, then monthly thereafter
HbA1c at baseline and every 3 months during therapy
CBC and liver function tests before starting and periodically
Monitor for diarrhea and cutaneous rash each cycle
clearanceChecks: fasting plasma glucose (< 160 mg/dL and HbA1c < 8.0% prior to initiation)
liver function tests (ALT/AST ≤ 2.5x ULN or ≤ 5x ULN with liver metastases)

doseModificationRules.condition: hyperglycemia: fasting glucose > 250 mg/dL to 500 mg/dL (grade 3)
doseModificationRules.text: Withhold capivasertib. Initiate or intensify antidiabetic therapy. When FPG recovers to ≤ 160 mg/dL, resume at reduced dose level (400 mg BID -> 320 mg BID -> 240 mg BID). Permanently discontinue if unable to tolerate 240 mg BID or for ketoacidosis.
Hold capivasertib until resolution to grade ≤ 1; resume at next lower dose level (320 mg BID).
Hold capivasertib until resolution to grade ≤ 1; resume at 320 mg BID. Discontinue permanently for suspected SJS/TEN or DRESS.

drugs.name: Capivasertib
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-Q 14 of 15. Capivasertib 400 mg PO twice daily on Days 1 to 4, 8 to 11, 15 to 18, and 22 to 25 of each 28-day cycle (4 days on, 3 days off weekly).

drugs.name: Fulvestrant
drugs.notes: Fulvestrant 500 mg IM (as two 250 mg injections, one in each buttock) on Days 1 and 15 of Cycle 1, then Day 1 of each subsequent 28-day cycle.
